title: SSB AM Demodulator Passband
text: Demodulate SSB-AM-modulated data, 1 input, 1 output, {Lowpass filter design method} sets Design method for lowpass filter; {Carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency in Hz, {Initial phase (rad)} sets the initial phase offset in radians, {Filter order} sets the order of lowpass filter, {Cutoff frequency}, {Passband ripple (dB)} sets the peak-to-peak passband ripple in dB and {Stopband ripple (dB)} sets the peak-to-peak stopband ripple in dB. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Carrier frequency (Hz)
params.values: Carrier frequency in Hz 300 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial phase (rad)
params.values: Initial phase offset in radians 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Lowpass filter design method
params.values: Design method for lowpass filter Butterworth (default) | Chebyshev type I | Chebyshev type II | Elliptic

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Order of lowpass filter 4 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Cutoff frequency
params.values: Cutoff frequency in Hz 300 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Passband ripple (dB)
params.values: Peak-to-peak passband ripple in dB 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stopband ripple (dB)
params.values: Peak-to-peak stopband ripple in dB 0.1 (default) | positive scalar
